title: Brunswick and Winnebago Gain Market Share at Fort Lauderdale Boat Show Despite Weaker Demand
summary: Brunswick Corporation (NYSE) and Winnebago Industries ((NYSE:WGO) increased their market share at the Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show despite a decline in overall boat sales volumes compared with the previous year, according to research from BMO Capital Markets. The investment bank maintained its Outperform ratings on both companies, highlighting their relative strength in a challenging recreational boating market.

title: WGO Q3 deep dive: market share gains and cost controls offset soft demand
summary: RV Manufacturer Winnebago (NYSE:WGO) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q4 2026), with sales falling 17% year on year to $645.1 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $2.73 billion at the midpoint came in 2.7% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.49 per share was 5.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
